verdict.rationale: The evidence shows electronic new-hire paperwork, where employees fill out personal info, direct deposit, W-4 and an electronic I-9. Nothing documents sending offer letters or other HR documents for e-signature, or storing signed documents per employee, so this is only an adjacent onboarding feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and keep them stored per employee
